A Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) is a software-defined networking capability on Apiculus Cloud that allows cloud users to simulate a traditional private cloud environment on a public cloud. Using VPC, users can control a host of features and configurations, including subnet/tier management, access control using ACLs, IPv4 NAT, managing site-to-site or remote VPN connections, and, in some advanced cases, terminating their MPLS connections directly on the VPC. In Apiculus, VPC is delivered using a virtual router (VR).
